sentences.text: For Petitioners: Ms. D.E.Anisree Sangavi  For Respondents: Mr.V.Vasanthakumar, Addl. G  ORDER
The petitioners land was acquired under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
Compensation in respect thereof was received by the petitioners.

Meanwhile, __________ Page2 of 4 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 03/02/2026 06:47:35 pm ) the petitioners came to know that enhanced compensation was paid in respect of lands covered under the same notification pursuant to order in L.A.O.P.No.110 of 2012.
After submitting an application under Section 28A of the enactment, the present writ petition has been filed.
2. Mr.V.Vasanthakumar, learned Additional Government Pleader, accepts notice for the respondents.
By handing over written instructions, he submits that necessary funds have been requested for from the requisitioning department for purposes of disbursing enhanced compensation.
Within a reasonable time from the receipt thereof, he submits that the enhanced compensation would be disbursed to the petitioners.

3. By recording the above submissions, this writ petition is disposed of by directing the second respondent to take necessary measures for the disbursement of enhanced compensation to the petitioners in terms of Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 as expeditiously as possible,
preferably
within a period of six months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order
